### Highlights | 更新内容

- **可粘贴的诊断报告里多了一个 `input` 段，这正是上游 issue 24 一直在等的东西。** 在此之前，“鼠标在串流过程中不动了”这个问题只留下一处痕迹：串流内叠层上的一行字，而叠层一消失，痕迹就没有了。真正能解释它的计数长在串流视图控制器和它的 `HIDSupport` 实例上，而“拷贝诊断报告”这个按钮可达的时候，这两个对象早就被释放了——于是玩家能贴出来的报告里，关于鼠标一个字都没有。这也正是那个 issue 为什么一直在要一张叠层截图，而不是要一份报告。这个段现在会带上：设置解析出来的鼠标策略、以及为它实际存储的那个数字；CoreHID 是否被该策略允许、本次会话是否尝试启动过驱动、是否真的送出过移动、失败的话原因是什么；最后一次真正把移动交给主机的发送者是谁、距今多久。打开“输入诊断”之后，还会再加上：到达 / 实际发出 / 被丢弃三类计数、原始位移与发出位移的对照、指针捕获与重新捕获的计数及其最常见原因，以及“每一个发送者各自把多少个包交给了主机”——相对路径与绝对路径分列。总量之所以不够，是因为 `rel=4180` 既可能是一个发送者写的，也可能是四个各写四分之一，而“此刻是谁握着鼠标”恰好就是 24 要问的那一句。
  The copyable diagnostics report has an `input` section, which is what upstream issue 24 has been waiting on. Until now a pointer that stopped moving during a session left exactly one trace: a line in the in-stream overlay, gone the moment the overlay is. The numbers that could explain it lived on the stream view controller and on its `HIDSupport` instance, and both are released before the copy button is reachable, so the report a player could paste had nothing at all about the mouse -- which is why that issue kept asking for a screenshot of an overlay instead of a report. The section now carries the strategy the settings resolved together with the number actually stored for it; whether CoreHID is allowed by that strategy, whether this session attempted to start the driver, whether it delivered movement, and the reason if it failed; and the sender that last handed motion to the host, with how long ago. With Input Diagnostics on it adds arrived versus dispatched versus suppressed counts, raw against sent deltas, the capture and rearm counters with their top reasons, and the packets that reached the host counted per sender, with the relative and absolute paths kept apart. The totals were never enough for that: the same `rel=4180` arrives whether one sender wrote all of it or four wrote a quarter each, and who is holding the pointer is the question 24 asks.

- **没采集的时候，报告不会打印 0。** 上面那些逐发送者的计数只在“输入诊断”开关打开时才会走。一个在开关关闭状态下跑的会话，会直接说明“没人计数”，而不是把一堆 0 贴出来——因为那些 0 看起来完全像是“鼠标一次都没动”，而事实是“没人开始数”。这正是这一版把“已验证”和“没采集”分开的地方。发送者那一行、策略那一行、CoreHID 那三个答案不依赖那个开关：它们由产生它们的代码写下来，所以开关关着的会话同样有这几行。于是这一版的复现要求变了：打开 `设置 → 应用 → 调试日志 → 输入诊断`，把鼠标卡住复现一次，再拷贝报告；`input` 段会指出是哪个发送者不再把移动交给主机。仍然没有测到的，也仍然写在文档里：关掉光标关联、并把指针 warp 到屏幕中心之后，`NSEvent.deltaX` 是否还保持非零。如果真机测出来是 0，那要改的是不依赖光标位置的位移来源，而不是文档里再多写一句。
  A session that ran without the switch says nobody was counting and prints no counters. The per-sender figures above only advance while Input Diagnostics is on, and zeros there are the most misleading thing this block could carry: they read as a pointer that never moved when what happened is that nobody started counting. That separation is the point of the block. The sender line, the strategy line and the three CoreHID answers do not depend on the switch -- the code that produces them writes them down -- so a session that ran with diagnostics off still has them. The reproduction ask therefore changes: turn on `Settings -> App -> Debug Log -> Input Diagnostics`, reproduce the frozen pointer, then paste the report, and the `input` section names which sender stopped handing motion over. What remains unmeasured stays written down as unmeasured: whether `NSEvent.deltaX` stays non-zero with the cursor association switched off and the pointer warped to the centre. If real hardware answers zero, the fix is a delta source that does not read cursor position, not another sentence in a document.

- **本版背后的门控状态**：本地门控 **40 通过 / 0 失败 / 10 项点名需要 CI 产物**；约束审计植入缺陷电池 **117/117** 全数抓到；诊断报告自己的测试 **35** 项全过，其中 **7** 项是往这个新段落里重新植入的缺陷（描述一个从未开始的会话、打印没人采集过的计数、把发送者那一行丢掉，都在其中）；本地化英文与中文各 **1131** 条 key、双向一致、**0** 失败（这一版没有新增任何界面文案——报告本身故意保持英文 key，因为读报告的人不是把菜单翻译成中文的那位玩家）；静态分析基线未增长（**0 new / 0 grown**）。相对上游 `master`，在本 tag 上量得：领先 **233** 个提交，196 个文件，+44019 / −4233。
  The gate state behind this build: the local sweep is **40 passed / 0 failed / 10 named as needing a CI artefact**; the constraint audit's planted-defect battery caught **117/117**; the report's own harness runs **35** checks, **7** of which are defects re-planted into this new block -- among them a block that describes a session that never started, one that prints counters nobody collected, and one that drops the sender line; localisation carries **1131** English and **1131** Chinese keys with **0** failures, and this build adds no interface text at all, because the report stays English on purpose: its reader is whoever triages the issue, not the player whose menus were translated; the static analyzer baseline did not grow (**0 new / 0 grown**). Against upstream `master`, measured at this tag: **233** commits ahead, 196 files, +44019 / −4233.

### Maintenance | 维护更新

- **这些数字为什么放进了一个新对象里。** 报告是在会话结束之后才被拷贝的，所以任何“还活着”的证据都不能长在会话对象上。新增的 `InputDiagnosticsLedger` 是进程里唯一的一份输入状态记录：写入方是鼠标代码所在的线程，读取方是写报告的主线程，两者之间由同一把锁隔开——写的一方不必知道报告什么时候会读，读的一方拿到的也是一张一致的快照而不是十七个正在被改的字段。新会话开始时，上一段的发送者与计数会被清空，但策略不会被清空：策略由决定它的那段代码重新写入，而那段代码的运行时机和这个方法并不对齐，宁可晚一点也不要少一行最要紧的“这次用的是哪个驱动”。
  Why these numbers live in an object of their own. The report is copied after the session is over, so nothing that has to be alive when it is read may live on the session. The new `InputDiagnosticsLedger` is the one copy of input state in the process: the mouse code writes it from whichever thread it happens to be on, the report reads it from the main queue, and the same lock sits between them, so a writer never has to know when a report will be assembled and a reader gets one consistent picture rather than seventeen properties someone is halfway through changing. A new session clears the previous one's senders and counters but deliberately keeps the strategy: the strategy is re-written by the code that decides it, whose timing does not line up with this method, and a report missing the one line about which driver was chosen is worse than one carrying it a moment too long.

- **记录点选在“做决定的地方”，而不是“显示的地方”。** 策略的名字、CoreHID 到底启没启、有没有真的送出移动、失败原因，都是从分支自己那里写进账本的；设置页不参与。24 号 issue 的起点就是一个标签和它的效果互相矛盾——名字写着 HID，作用却是关掉 CoreHID——所以一份从显示文案拼出来的报告只会把同一个错误再说一遍。为此报告打印的是枚举的 case 名，而不是菜单上那行字。还有一个新文件必须被真正编译：`InputDiagnosticsLedger.m` 加进了 target 成员列表，而 `compiled-source-audit.py` 从链接好的 Mach-O 里读回类名，确认 **82** 个第一方类**一个都没漏**——这个项目曾经有过一个类被提交、通过编译、却在产物里根本不存在。
  The recording sites are where the decisions are made, not where they are displayed. The strategy name, whether CoreHID started, whether it delivered movement, and why it failed are written into the ledger by the branches themselves; the settings page takes no part. Issue 24 began with a label and an effect that contradicted each other -- the row said HID and its only effect was to stop CoreHID -- so a report assembled out of display strings would say the same wrong thing again, which is why the report prints the enum case name rather than the menu text. The new file also had to be really compiled: `InputDiagnosticsLedger.m` is in the target's member list, and `compiled-source-audit.py` reads class names back out of the linked Mach-O, confirming **82** first-party classes with **none** missing -- this repository has previously shipped a class that was committed, compiled on its own, and simply absent from the product.
